hints.title: Geometric Series Formulation
hints.text: A base k representation of n consisting solely of ones is a geometric series sum of powers of k.

hints.title: Length Bound on Number of Ones
hints.text: Since k >= 2, the number of digits m in base k satisfies 2^m <= n, meaning m ranges from 2 up to at most 62.

hints.title: Iterating Length with Target Base Search
hints.text: To minimize base k, iterate m from floor(log2(n)) down to 2. Approximate k as floor(n^(1/m)). If the polynomial sum of powers of k equals n exactly, return k as a string. Otherwise fall back to base n - 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: numerical value of string n
complexity.notes: Testing at most 62 possible bit-lengths with polynomial evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every base k linearly from 2 up to N takes O(N) operations which exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating powers m in descending order enables immediate return of smallest base in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model geometric series and bound exponent m by log2(N).
